text:
I called, I called like the blissful castaway

to the executioner waves

that know the true name

of death.


I have called the wind,

I entrusted to it my desire to be.


But a dead bird

flies toward hopelessness

in the midst of music

when witches and flowers

cut off the hand of mist.

A dead bird called blue.


It is not solitude with wings,

it is the silence of the prisoner,

it is the muteness of birds and wind,

it is the world angry at my laughter

or the guardians of hell

breaking my letters.


I have called, I have called.

I have called toward never.

translation.title: I Called, I Called Like the Blissful Castaway...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the repeated calling and the final movement toward never.
